title: From Natural Language Policies to Executable Obligations: A Verification Harness for Dependable In-Car LLM Agents
title_zh: 从自然语言策略到可执行义务：面向可靠车载 LLM Agent 的验证框架
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) agents deployed in vehicles must satisfy a written operating policy on every turn: a single hallucinated identifier, omitted mandatory side-effect, or premature completion claim fails the task. We present AgentGuardUtil, our entry to CAR-bench Track~1, which treats the AI planer (LLM) as a fallible proposer inside a grounded verify-and-revise loop. Its core novelty is a runtime policy compiler: the natural-language policy shipped with each conversation is compiled, once per policy, into typed machine-checkable rules, a subset of which receive an executable form. A deterministic obligation engine interprets these rules against live tool results and the simulated post-write state of the draft itself, emitting the exact remedial calls with computed arguments rather than natural-language reminders. Around this engine, 25 deterministic gates (identifier provenance, schema and enum validity, gather-before-act, confirmation and future-time protocols) and an LLM critic produce tiered findings that drive a bounded revision loop tuned for the pass k metric.
abstract_zh: 部署于车辆中的 Large Language Model（LLM）Agent 必须在每轮交互中严格遵守书面运行策略；任何一次标识符幻觉、强制副作用遗漏或过早宣称任务完成，都会导致任务失败。本文提出 AgentGuardUtil，这是作者参加 CAR-bench Track 1 的方案。该方法将 AI 规划器（LLM）视为可能出错的提议者，并将其置于基于事实的“验证—修订”闭环中。其核心创新是运行时策略编译器：针对每段对话附带的自然语言策略，仅需编译一次，即可转换为带类型、可由机器检查的规则，其中部分规则还会被转化为可执行形式。确定性的义务引擎结合实时工具返回结果，以及草案执行写操作后的模拟状态来解释这些规则；当发现违规时，它会直接生成参数已计算完毕的精确补救调用，而非仅给出自然语言提醒。在该引擎外围，系统设置了 25 个确定性门控机制，覆盖标识符来源、Schema 与枚举合法性、先收集后执行、确认协议及未来时间协议等，并结合 LLM critic 生成分级问题报告，驱动一个有界修订循环，以优化 pass k 指标表现。
key_points_zh: 将 LLM 定位为可能出错的方案提议者，而不是直接执行决策的可信组件。
提出运行时策略编译器，把自然语言运行策略转换为带类型、机器可检查且部分可执行的规则。
确定性义务引擎同时检查实时工具结果与草案执行后的模拟状态，并生成参数完整的补救调用。
通过 25 个确定性门控机制验证标识符来源、Schema、枚举值、操作顺序、用户确认和未来时间约束。
结合 LLM critic 与分级问题报告，在有界验证—修订循环中提升 CAR-bench Track 1 的 pass k 表现。

llm_assessment.comment: The policy compiler, executable obligation engine, and bounded verification loop form a credible runtime harness, although the implementation is tightly tied to an in-car benchmark.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 策略编译器、可执行义务引擎和有界验证闭环构成了可信的运行时框架，但实现与车载基准绑定较紧。
